title: moeb-tool-origin rubric fail: Read tool used without MissingMoebTool signal
description: The Claude Code Read tool was used to read the truncated start_run result file at an absolute temp path (C:\Users\Simeon\.claude\projects\...\mcp-moeb-start_run-*.txt) outside the working directory. No MissingMoebTool signal was buffered at the time of the external call, causing the moeb-tool-origin criterion to fail.
proposed_resolution: Buffer a MissingMoebTool signal immediately after any external tool call. For future runs, extend start_run to page its output within MCP response limits, or add a moeb tool for reading files at absolute paths outside the working directory.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000057: ToolSearch is a legitimate pre-skill bootstrapping tool (no moeb equivalent needed); moeb-tool-origin rubric needs updating to exempt it.
